ownerDecision: A13 (2026-10-11, owner via the lane monitor): a separate later record in the next harness-onion meta packet that touches the registry; R12's CONF-CI-001 bootstrap is the precedent until then.
rules: The consumer holds exactly these bytes and modes; a new file, or another version of a listed file, needs a new registry record (a harness-onion meta packet) before any consumer packet uses it.
Data contracts, contract text and transport files only; no product implementation source crosses the repository boundary (architecture/repositories.yaml:10).
harness-engineering consumes no repository in any graph of architecture/repositories.yaml, so this edge cannot close a cycle; the layer checks every unconditional graph.

statuses.IN_USE: held by the consumer since the named packet (registered retroactively)

notes: consumerCommit is the consumer packet's merge commit at which the four files were read; only those four paths were read in the consumer repository.
The modes are the provider files' modes as v1 records them; the consumer's own modes were not read, since listing its tree would read other paths.
